scenes.tts: Push a small bead into the back of a chick embryo's forebrain. It is soaked in one protein, F G F eight. A second midbrain can grow there, built back to front. Who tells cells what to build?
scenes.caption: Push a small bead into the back of a chick embryo's forebrain. It is soaked in one protein, FGF8. A second midbrain can grow there, built back to front. Who tells cells what to build?
scenes.visual: Visual language: one flat strip of neural tube, front at left; slate Otx2, sage Gbx2, gold Fgf8, clay Wnt1. Title card: Where the Line Falls. A bead drops into the forebrain of a chick tube outline; a second midbrain shape grows beside it, its parts labelled in reverse order. Freeze on the question.
scenes.narration: Push a small bead into the back of a chick embryo's forebrain. It is soaked in one protein, FGF8. A second midbrain can grow there, built back to front. Who tells cells what to build?

scenes.tts: Hox genes give the hindbrain and spinal cord their addresses. The midbrain and forebrain have no Hox code at all.
scenes.visual: Hox colours fill the hindbrain from rhombomere 2 back, and the spinal cord, then stop. Rhombomere 1, the midbrain and the forebrain stay grey.
scenes.narration: Hox genes give the hindbrain and spinal cord their addresses. The midbrain and forebrain have no Hox code at all.

scenes.tts: Front at the left: forebrain, then midbrain, then a narrowing called the isthmus. Behind it, the roof of rhombomere one gives rise to the cerebellum.
scenes.caption: Front at the left: forebrain, then midbrain, then a narrowing called the isthmus. Behind it, the roof of rhombomere 1 gives rise to the cerebellum.
scenes.visual: Labels appear one at a time along the strip: forebrain (diencephalon at its back), midbrain (tectum on its roof), isthmus, rhombomere 1, with an arrow to cerebellum.
scenes.narration: Front at the left: forebrain, then midbrain, then a narrowing called the isthmus. Behind it, the roof of rhombomere 1 gives rise to the cerebellum.

scenes.tts: A local organizer is a small signaling center inside the tube. It tells nearby cells what to build. The best studied sits at the isthmus.
scenes.visual: A small loudspeaker icon at the isthmus with sound rings reaching the neighbouring tissue. Label: local organizer.
scenes.narration: A local organizer is a small signaling center inside the tube. It tells nearby cells what to build. The best studied sits at the isthmus.

scenes.tts: It comes down to one idea. A line becomes a source.
scenes.visual: Title card: A line becomes a source.
scenes.narration: It comes down to one idea. A line becomes a source.

scenes.tts: Where O T X two meets G B X two, the boundary cells become a signaling source. F G F eight is the chief signal.
scenes.caption: Where Otx2 meets Gbx2, the boundary cells become a signaling source. FGF8 is the chief signal.
scenes.visual: Slate Otx2 fills the front of the strip, sage Gbx2 the back; a gold glow appears at their meeting line. First clause appears: where it is.
scenes.narration: Where Otx2 meets Gbx2, the boundary cells become a signaling source. FGF8 is the chief signal.

scenes.tts: On the simplest reading, how much signal a cell gets tells it which part to build. The repressor it carries sets which region it can become. In the roof of the tube, that means midbrain in front and cerebellum behind.
scenes.visual: Gold rings spread both ways from the line. Second clause: signal tells which part. Third clause: the repressor sets which region it can become. Only the roof next to the line is labelled: slate roof labelled midbrain (tectum), sage roof of rhombomere 1 labelled cerebellum. The rest of the forebrain and hindbrain stays unlabelled.
scenes.narration: On the simplest reading, how much signal a cell gets tells it which part to build. The repressor it carries sets which region it can become. In the roof of the tube, that means midbrain in front and cerebellum behind.

scenes.tts: Start with the line. O T X two is on in the forebrain and midbrain. G B X two is on in the front of the hindbrain. Each represses the other.
scenes.caption: Start with the line. Otx2 is on in the forebrain and midbrain. Gbx2 is on in the front of the hindbrain. Each represses the other.
scenes.visual: The strip again: slate over forebrain and midbrain, sage over the front of the hindbrain; two blunt repression arrows point at each other across the line.
scenes.narration: Start with the line. Otx2 is on in the forebrain and midbrain. Gbx2 is on in the front of the hindbrain. Each represses the other.

scenes.tts: A cell with a little more O T X two makes less G B X two. Its neighbour does the opposite. So a blurred edge can sharpen, and the line sits where the two meet. How sharp depends on how strong and switch-like the repression is.
scenes.caption: A cell with a little more Otx2 makes less Gbx2. Its neighbour does the opposite. So a blurred edge can sharpen, and the line sits where the two meet. How sharp depends on how strong and switch-like the repression is.
scenes.visual: Two cells at the line each hold both colours; one tips to slate, its neighbour tips to sage. The blurred, overlapping edge sharpens into a clean line, which pulses.
scenes.narration: A cell with a little more Otx2 makes less Gbx2. Its neighbour does the opposite. So a blurred edge can sharpen, and the line sits where the two meet. How sharp depends on how strong and switch-like the repression is.

scenes.tts: Predict. In a mouse, force O T X two on in the front of the hindbrain. Where should the line go? What happens to the cerebellum?
scenes.caption: Predict. In a mouse, force Otx2 on in the front of the hindbrain. Where should the line go? What happens to the cerebellum?
scenes.visual: On-screen prompt: Force Otx2 into the front of the hindbrain. Where does the line go? The prompt stays on screen.
scenes.narration: Predict. In a mouse, force Otx2 on in the front of the hindbrain. Where should the line go? What happens to the cerebellum?

scenes.tts: The line moves back, with its band of F G F eight. The cerebellum is smaller. Broccoli, Boncinelli and Wurst showed this in nineteen ninety-nine.
scenes.caption: The line moves back, with its band of FGF8. The cerebellum is smaller. Broccoli, Boncinelli and Wurst showed this in 1999.
scenes.visual: Slate creeps back into the hindbrain; the line and the gold Fgf8 band move with it; the cerebellum outline shrinks. Credit: Broccoli, Boncinelli and Wurst, 1999.
scenes.narration: The line moves back, with its band of FGF8. The cerebellum is smaller. Broccoli, Boncinelli and Wurst showed this in 1999.

scenes.tts: Millet and colleagues did the reverse. G B X two made in the back of the midbrain moved the line forward.
scenes.caption: Millet and colleagues did the reverse. Gbx2 made in the back of the midbrain moved the line forward.
scenes.visual: Reverse case: sage pushes forward into the back of the midbrain and the line moves forward. Credit: Millet and colleagues, Joyner laboratory, 1999.
scenes.narration: Millet and colleagues did the reverse. Gbx2 made in the back of the midbrain moved the line forward.

scenes.tts: This is a move-it test. Change where the players are, and see if the pattern follows. The line follows the repressors.
scenes.visual: Icon: move it, with an arrow shifting the slate edge and the line following. Label: move-it test.
scenes.narration: This is a move-it test. Change where the players are, and see if the pattern follows. The line follows the repressors.

scenes.tts: Right at the line, cells make secreted signals: F G F eight just behind it, Wint one just in front. This line is more than a fence.
scenes.caption: Right at the line, cells make secreted signals: FGF8 just behind it, Wnt1 just in front. This line is more than a fence.
scenes.visual: Gold Fgf8 band lights up just behind the line, clay Wnt1 ring just in front. A fence icon fades out.
scenes.narration: Right at the line, cells make secreted signals: FGF8 just behind it, Wnt1 just in front. This line is more than a fence.

scenes.tts: Takeaway: two repressors place the line. Next, is that line a source?
scenes.visual: Closing card: two repressors place the line. Is the line a source?
scenes.narration: Takeaway: two repressors place the line. Next, is that line a source?
